Purpose: Redirect the stick to this host for near-realtime power. Shine stays usable via cloud forward.
Remove redirect confirm: Reset this stick to Growatt cloud and remove the local redirect?
Hardware hint: Built for ShineWiFi-X (:5279). ShineLAN-X may work the same way. X2 sticks and ShineWiFi-S are not supported.
Night offline hint: Often offline at night — wait until connected.
Next select empty: Next: check plant credentials or wait for sticks to appear.
Next status empty: Next: select a stick above and redirect it.
Setup timeout: Timeout — check Status (stick may still be rebooting; often 1–4 min).
Patch progress hint: Redirect running — stick reboots and reconnects, often 1–4 minutes. Keep this page open.
Waiting reconnect hint: Waiting for the stick to reconnect after reboot (TCP to this host).
Redirect done hint: Redirect is configured. Status shows online when the stick is connected.
